title: In c58's trait vortices only dm/sw sets the trait cloud: runs with the same ratio coincide in units of sw (an exact symmetry of the equations), and at dm/sw 0.5 the cloud stays near neutral while at 1 it keeps widening to t=6000
summary: c58's trait3d world is invariant under scaling the trait, the mutation step dm and the waste kernel width sw by one factor: z, V, the mutation increment and theta are linear in the trait, G depends only on |theta - theta_W|/sw, and nothing else reads the trait. Checked on c61's seed 15 / mut_seed 15 (T=6000, standard waste, ew 0.25): dm 0.8/sw 0.8 reproduces c61's dm 0.4/sw 0.4 run and dm 0.2/sw 0.4 reproduces c61's dm 0.4/sw 0.8 run, with cloud radius ratios 1.992-2.006 in every 500-t window (the small residual is floating-point divergence of chaotic trajectories). So c61's sw 0.8 result (20261028T0409) is a change of dm/sw from 1 to 0.5, not of sw; in units of sw the cloud reaches R/sw 2.6 at dm/sw 1 and 0.5 at dm/sw 0.5 by t=6000. The open axis is therefore dm/sw alone (with ew and the waste's lifetime and reach); runs at dm/sw 2 and a kind-blind twin are running.

finding.operator: joint scaling of trait, mutation step dm and waste kernel width sw
finding.control: same seed and mutation draws, (dm, sw) = (0.4, 0.4) vs (0.8, 0.8) and (0.4, 0.8) vs (0.2, 0.4)
finding.result: cloud radius ratio 1.992-2.006 in every 500-t window to t=6000; R/sw at t=6000: 2.6 (dm/sw 1), 0.5 (dm/sw 0.5)
